test.title: Electrochemistry - Test 3

test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text: Identify the factor from the following that does not affect electrolytic conductance of a solution.

options.text: The nature of the electrolyte added.
The nature of the electrode used.
